result.topic_en: A general remark on cubic fields: from the equations (α−a')/(β−b') = b/α = β/a, Dedekind defines auxiliary numbers and ideals m, n with m+n=o and gives the ideal factorizations of ob, o(α−a'), oβ, oa, oα, o(β−b'), noting that for the cubic cyclotomic field a_1=b_1=1.
result.transcription:
Allgemeine Bemerkung zu den cubischen Körpern.

Die Gleichungen $\frac{\alpha - a'}{\beta - b'} = \frac{b}{\alpha} = \frac{\beta}{a}$ geben Veranlassung zu folgenden Zerlegungen. Man setze
$[a, b'] = [a_1]$, $[b, a'] = [b_1]$; $[a_1, b_1] = [1]$; $c = \frac{ab - a'b'}{a_1 b_1}$;
$\frac{a'}{b_1} r \equiv \frac{a}{a_1}$, $\frac{b}{b_1} r \equiv \frac{b'}{a_1}$; $rs \equiv 1 \pmod{c}$.
Dann sind Ideale:
$m = [b, \alpha - a', \beta]$, $n = [a, \alpha, \beta - b']$; $m + n = o$
$ob = m[b, \alpha, b\beta] = [b, b\alpha, b\beta]$
$o(\alpha - a') = m[ca_1 b_1, \alpha - a', \beta - b'] = [bca_1, \alpha - a', b_1\beta - ba_1 r]$
$o\beta = m[a, a\alpha, \beta] = [ab, a(\alpha - a'), \beta]$
und ebenso
$oa = n[a, a\alpha, \beta] = [a, a\alpha, a\beta]$
$o\alpha = n[b, \alpha, b\beta] = [ab, \alpha, b(\beta - b')]$
$o(\beta - b') = n[ca_1 b_1, \alpha - a', \beta - b'] = [acb_1, a_1\alpha - ab_1 s, \beta - b']$.
Im Falle der obigen cubischen Kreistheilungs-Körper (mag $M$ gerade oder ungerade sein) ist immer $a_1 = b_1 = 1$.
